title: watsonx.ai reviews the finished change for risk areas instead of second-guessing each step

outcome: Granite writes alternative readings for an assumption card when Bob gives none, and a hidden-assumption card after every edit; the mission report carries no review of the change.
Assumption cards offer only Bob's own alternative readings, and an edit on its own produces no card.
forbid: the knowledge agent's spec check stays as it is — it checks Bob against the task's documents, not against himself
end_session's cards for Bob's own stated assumptions stay
tests may be deleted only where they cover the removed alternatives or per-edit card; no test of kept behaviour changes

outcome: An accepted mission report carries at most 3 risk areas from Granite, each naming a file the hooks saw Bob edit and why it is risky.
forbid: end_session must answer inside Bob's 60 s MCP timeout — the risk review may not add its wait after the 45 s final-review wait
a risk whose file Bob did not edit is dropped, never shown
without watsonx credentials the report has no risk areas and nothing else changes
one LLM call per accepted report, not one per edit
the risk-area type is declared once in packages/contracts

outcome: The mission report screen lists the risk areas when the report carries them.
forbid: a report without risk areas renders exactly as today

evidence: declare_step no longer calls the card writer for alternatives (mcp.ts) and the /hook route no longer runs a per-edit review (server.ts); addAlternatives, reviewEdit, the diff question, store.lastIntent, parseList and the ALTERNATIVES/HIDDEN prompts are gone. specCheck untouched; end_session assumption cards untouched. Tests deleted: writer.test.ts 'the card writer' block (alternatives, per-edit card, parseList). Test fixtures moved to the new CardWriter shape with assertions unchanged: docs.test.ts, confirm.test.ts; watsonx.test.ts plumbing test now drives reviewRisks; writer.test.ts option-A test lost only its 'card writer is not asked' assertion. Gate 0 clean (only the new goal log, untracked); typecheck green; vitest 29 files / 150 tests pass.

Hooks keep every edit's patch in usage.diffs (report.ts countToolCall). end_session starts reviewRisks right after the unreported-files check, in parallel with the 45 s final review, and awaits it only when building the accepted report. Risks are path-normalised, dropped unless in usage.edited, capped at 3; report.risks is omitted when empty. RiskArea is declared once in packages/contracts/records.ts. Known cost: an end_session sent back by a developer objection has already spent its one review call (still one per end_session, never per edit). New risk-review.test.ts (4 tests: filter+cap+single call, no creds/no risks, no call when nothing edited or report sent back, concurrency under fake timers). Gate 0 clean; typecheck green; vitest 30 files / 154 tests pass.

mission-report.ts renders a RISK AREAS · GRANITE REVIEW list (file:line — risk, escaped) after CHANGES when report.risks is non-empty; styled .rep-risks/.rep-h.risk in index.html. A report without risks renders identically to one with an empty list (new mission-report-risks.test.ts); existing mission-report.test.ts unchanged and passing. Browser pass skipped: BROWSER_VERIFY_SKILL is empty in harness.conf. Gate 0 clean; typecheck green; vitest 31 files / 156 tests pass.

disposition: Shipped: watsonx.ai no longer writes alternatives or per-edit hidden-assumption cards; it reviews the finished change once at end_session and the mission report shows at most 3 risk areas in files Bob edited. Spec check kept. Invariant 8 and the quiz design doc updated for the report's new risks field.
